Impacted Systems: Devices vulnerable to CVE-2021-35394 (Realtek Jungle SDK)
Devices vulnerable to CVE-2022-46169 (Cacti fault management monitoring tool)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2021-35394 and CVE-2022-46169 vulnerabilities
Method of Attack: Targets CVE-2021-35394 and CVE-2022-46169 to infect vulnerable hosts, downloads configuration script, connects to C2 server, exchanges heartbeat messages, initiates attacks on command, scans for and kills processes of other bots to maximize hardware power for DDoS attacks
Indicators of Compromise: Overlapping attack bursts exploiting CVE-2021-35394 and CVE-2022-46169
